jobs.title: UGC Creators 40+ Needed for Simple At-Home Product Videos – Ongoing Work - Contract to Hire
jobs.description:
We are looking for male and female UGC creators aged 40+ to create simple, natural lifestyle footage for one of our products.

The product is the Livsken Restwrap, a wearable wrap designed to be used around the hands, wrists, and fingers.

This is a very simple UGC project. All footage can be filmed at home with your smartphone. You do not need a professional camera, lighting setup, microphone, studio, or editing skills. Natural phone footage is exactly what we are looking for.

There is no talking required and no script to read. We only need raw visual footage showing the product being used naturally during everyday life.

Examples of the footage we need include:

Putting/wrapping the Restwrap around the wrist and hand

Using it around the fingers

Wearing it naturally at home

Wearing it while watching TV

Wearing it while relaxing

Wearing it while doing light household activities

Other simple everyday lifestyle situations

We will provide reference videos for every shot, so you can simply recreate the same type of footage with our product.

For each project, we generally need around 7 different shots of approximately 40 seconds each, resulting in roughly 5 minutes of raw footage in total.

The filming itself is very straightforward and can be done quickly and easily with your phone.

Creator Requirements

We are currently looking for:

Men and women aged 40+

Creators from:

United States

Western Europe

Eastern Europe

Comfortable appearing naturally on camera

Able to record clear smartphone footage at home

Able to follow simple visual reference videos

No professional filming or editing experience required

We are especially interested in creators who are available for an ongoing weekly collaboration.

When applying, please send us a recent photo or example of previous UGC/lifestyle content and let us know your age range and country.
